description: This file defines the FoodService class, responsible for loading, searching, and retrieving food data from a local JSON asset in a Flutter application.

classes.name: FoodService
classes.description: Handles loading and searching food data from a JSON asset, provides methods for querying food items by name or search term.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the service by loading and parsing the JSON data into FoodItem objects, then sorts them alphabetically.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches food items by query string; returns up to 'limit' matching items.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a food item by exact name match (case-insensitive).

methods.name: all
methods.description: Getter that returns all loaded food items.
